podcast.title: Archivist of Early Demos
podcast.body: Years after Our Lady Peace's first demo was initially overlooked, guitarist Mike Turner was able to retrieve another copy of that original cassette from his archives, allowing it to be heard. "And after I told him the story, he was kind enough to go back into his archives and dig out another copy of that original demo."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Edwin Forms Crash Karma (2008)
xref.body: In 2008, Edwin partnered with Mike Turner (formerly of Our Lady Peace) and Jeff Burrows (of The Tea Party) to form the band Crash Karma. "Then in 2008, he joined up with Mike Turner, ex of our lady piece, and Jeff Burrows of the Tea Party in a band called Crash Karma."
